display_title: In This Life I Will Retire

titles_en.title: In This Life I Will Retire

description:
An ordinary aspiring web novel writer, Ji-Kyung Yu. After losing her fiancé in an accident and having her novel filled with her memories plagiarized, she falls into despair and dies… just when she thinks she has completely died, she finds herself possessed by the romance fantasy novel she wrote, Calathea on the Cliff. But… not in the body of the main character, but of the villainess ‘Celestia’! As the original author, Ji-kyung Yu (Celestia + Ji-kyung Yoo) feels an unbearable rage when she sees the content that the plagiarist has arbitrarily changed. She tries to use her rewriting ability, which allows her to change the progression of the novel by revising the content of the book, to create the ending she wants…

Will Ji-Kyung be able to overcome the villains and the plagiarist’s interference in the novel and create the happy ending she wants?

(Source: Naver, translated)
